name: Flame Rod
desc: A staff specialized in creating and controlling crackling flames, formed from brass and charred wood and reinforced with flame essence.
prereqs: A creature must be flamebound to use this _Weapon_.

abilities.name: Flame Focus
abilities.effect: Gain 1 _Essence_ at _Respite_. You may spend up to 2 _Momentum_ to gain an equivalent amount of _Essence_.

abilities.name: Enhanced Craft
abilities.effect: You have increased precision and control when using this item to aid in your craft.

name: Iron Dagger
desc: A small, versatile blade that has a myriad of uses.

analysis_notes.notes: 4+6 and 6+4 is two more potential Gambits for 5.55%, x2 for 2 Momentum

enhances.name: Flurry
enhances.effect: Use _Strike_ again. You may not apply this _Enhancement_ to the secondary attack.

enhances.name: Find The Gap
enhances.effect: You must have _Advantage_ to use this _Enhancement_. Add [_Piercing_]. On a _Hit_+, deal +2 _Damage_.

enhances.name: Precise Fling
enhances.effect: Make this Attack at _Advantage_. On a _Graze_+, deal +1 _Bonus Damage_.

name: Iron Javelin
desc: A light lance that can be easily flung or used in melee.

enhances.name: Lunge
enhances.effect: Range is instead 0. Deal +_0/1/1/2_ Damage.

enhances.name: Hand-and-a-Half
enhances.effect: If you are _Wielding_ this Weapon two-handed, deal +_0/1/2/3_ Damage.

enhances.name: Hop Step
enhances.effect: Create an [_Opening_] when you Attack, and you may not attack Targets closer than Range 1. Range is instead 2, and you deal +_0/1/2/3_ Damage.

name: Iron Throwing Knives
desc: Small blades meant for sudden, unexpected throws. They're unsuited for melee combat, but can be thrown with a high degree of accuracy.
effect: While _Wielding_ this you have any number of _Missiles_ (_Metal_) on your person. When you use these _Missiles_, the effect deals _Stab_ _Damage_ instead of its usual type. You may treat this as a _Minor Source_ (_Metal_) by losing one _Ammunition_.

enhances.name: Precise Fling
enhances.effect: Make this Attack at _Advantage_. On a _Graze_+, deal +1 _Bonus Damage_.

name: Iron Longsword
desc: A sword that grants the perfect flexibility between damage and speed. It is a favorite of travelers due to its versatility in combat.

enhances.name: Hand-and-a-Half
enhances.effect: Deal +_0/1/2/2_ Damage. If you are _Wielding_ this Weapon two-handed, instead deal +_1/2/2/3_ Damage.

enhances.name: Thrusting Strike
enhances.effect: Damage type is instead _Stab_. Add [_Piercing_]. Deal +_0/2/3/4_ Damage.

name: Round Shield
desc: A round shield made largely of wood capable of absorbing a large number of attacks.

abilities.name: Protective Shield
abilities.effect: Gain +2 _Block_. You gain +1 to _Defense Rolls_ against _Ranged_ Attacks. These benefits stack with _Cover_.

enhances.name: Heavy Slam
enhances.effect: Add +_0/0/1/2_ Damage and _Push_ [1/3].

name: Iron Battleaxe
desc: A solid, hefty axe useful for hacking through a foes' defenses.

enhances.name: Hand-and-a-Half
enhances.effect: Deal +_0/1/2/2_ Damage. If you are _Wielding_ this Weapon two-handed, also add [_Piercing_].

enhances.name: Cleave
enhances.effect: Do not make an _Attack Roll_. Instead, automatically _Graze_ all creatures in your _Engagement_.

enhances.name: Hack
enhances.effect: Add _Exposed_ [3] to the Attack. Add [_Bane_ (_Wood_)]

name: Quarterstaff
desc: A thick sturdy staff that is just as useful for battle as it is for traveling.

abilities.name: Walking Stick
abilities.effect: When traveling on uneven or difficult terrain you may remove a single _Affliction_ or _Fatigue_ _Danger_ related to said Terrain.

enhances.name: Hand-and-a-Half
enhances.effect: Deal +_0/1/1/2_ Stun and +_0/1/1/1_ Damage. If you are _Wielding_ this Weapon two-handed, instead deal +_0/2/3/3_ Stun and +_0/1/1/2_ Damage.

name: Stone Maul
desc: A crude maul made with a heavy stone that is far heavier than its metallic counterparts.

abilities.name: Whirl
abilities.effect: You begin to whirl your weapon. Whenever any creature spends _Speed_ within your _Arena_ or enters it they must spend an additional _Speed_ or you immediately use _Strike_ from _Stone Maul_ against them [_Discount_ 2, _Follow-Up_]. If a creature is attempting to _Engage_ you, you have _Advantage_ on this Attack. End this effect if a creature becomes _Engaged_ with you, you are knocked _Prone_, or you are no longer _Wielding_ this _Weapon_. This _Occupies_ the _Stone Maul_.

enhances.name: Restraint
enhances.effect: You may use this at any time to not make an Attack.

enhances.name: Extend
enhances.effect: Range is 0 [_Reach_]. Deal +2 _Stun_.

enhances.name: Slam
enhances.effect: Add _Shatter_ [4], _Push_ [2/4], or _Prone_ [4]. You may repeat this _Enhancement_, choosing a different option each time.

enhances.name: Smash
enhances.effect: All _Stun_ is _Damage_.

enhances.name: Cleave
enhances.effect: Automatically _Graze_ all creatures in your _Engagement_ instead of Attacking.

enhances.name: Greater Cleave
enhances.effect: After resolving the Attack, _Graze_ all other creatures in your _Engagement_.

name: Hunting Sling
desc: A simple weapon with a windup that pierces through many defenses.
effect: A small pouch of slingstones is included with this weapon that is comprised of _Earth_ _Missiles_. If you ever run out of ammunition, you may always collect more the next time you make Camp without using an action.

abilities.name: Loose
abilities.effect: Create an [_Opening_], then Attack a Target within Range.

enhances.name: Whirl
enhances.effect: Add [_Piercing_] to the Attack and, on a _Hit_+, deal +1 Damage. You may only Attack Targets at Range 2 when making the Attack in this way.

name: Hunting Bow
desc: A bow excellent for hunting game, but also for taking shots at foes.
effect: You must have a _Quiver_ and arrows to use this Weapon.

enhances.name: Full Draw
enhances.effect: Create an [_Opening_] when you Attack, and you may not attack Targets closer than Range 2. Deal +_0/2/4/5_ Damage.

enhances.name: Arcing Shot
enhances.effect: Range is instead 3, and you take no penalties due to _Cover_. If the Target has already taken a _Turn_ this _Round_, this Attack has _Disadvantage_.
